title: The Marathon Inside
description: Recovering from illness, Clara proves to herself that resilience is built one small step at a time.

scenes.narration: Everyone said Clara was too fragile to finish the trail run after her long illness. But she tied her laces anyway, determined to reclaim her strength.
scenes.visual: A woman tying her running shoe laces on a wooden bench outdoors in early morning light

scenes.narration: The cold morning air burned her lungs, and her legs felt heavy after the first two miles. Doubt whispered in her head, telling her to stop.
scenes.visual: Woman running along a dirt trail through a quiet pine forest as sunlight filters through trees

scenes.narration: Instead of giving up, Clara shortened her stride and focused on the path right in front of her. One single step at a time was all she needed.
scenes.visual: Close-up of running shoes stepping firmly onto a muddy woodland path

scenes.narration: At the steep incline, her body ached, but her spirit soared. She was no longer running against others, she was running for herself.
scenes.visual: Woman resting her hands on her knees catching her breath while looking up a hillside path

scenes.narration: As she reached the peak, the valley stretched out before her in magnificent golden light. Sweat poured down her face, mixed with tears of pure joy.
scenes.visual: Woman standing atop a grassy mountain hill overlooking a sunlit panoramic valley with arms open wide

scenes.narration: Clara realized resilience was not about never falling down, but about trusting her power to keep moving forward.
scenes.visual: Woman smiling gently with sweat on her brow glowing in afternoon golden sunlight outdoors

scenes.narration: You are stronger than any obstacle in your way. Follow along for daily stories of courage and growth.
scenes.visual: Peaceful woman standing in nature looking calmly toward the sun with a hopeful expression

character_reference: A young woman with a lean athletic build, shoulder-length wavy brown hair, wearing a moisture-wicking navy blue athletic tank top and dark grey running shorts with a distinctive small silver pendant necklace.
